verdict.rationale: Teller documents its own drop-in connection component, Teller Connect, with a first-party React hook and component, and lets users connect accounts at more than 7,000 institutions without the developer building institution UI. The evidence does not show a server-side session-creation step or what token the widget returns for the connected account. Missing for 10: documented server-side session/token creation, documented callback returning an access token for the enrollment, independent hands-on corroboration of the Connect flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let a user connect their bank with a drop-in hosted flow — create a session server-side, open the widget, and get back a token for the connected account — without building institution UI myself
